Saint Charbel: biography and milestones

Saint Charbel Makhlouf was a Lebanese Maronite monk and priest. His life invites us to discover prayer, silence, work, and faithfulness to God. These milestones offer a starting point, with references for further reading.

In this guide

  1. His beginnings in Lebanon
  2. A monastic and priestly vocation
  3. The Annaya hermitage
  4. Recognition by the Church
  5. Learning from his life today
  6. Reading as a family

His beginnings in Lebanon

Born Youssef Antoun Makhlouf in Bkaakafra on May 8, 1828, he grew up in a Christian family. He later entered monastic life and took the name Charbel. Charbel, Sharbel, and شربل refer to the same saint; spelling varies with language and transliteration.

A monastic and priestly vocation

His vocation belongs to the Maronite tradition, an Eastern Catholic Church. Community life, the Eucharist, prayer, and daily work shaped his path. This ordinary faithfulness matters as much as the extraordinary accounts associated with his memory.

The Annaya hermitage

Charbel entered the hermitage of Saints Peter and Paul in February 1875. He continued a life of prayer there until his death on December 24, 1898. His silence can inspire a short time of reflection without requiring everyone to imitate the austerities of his particular vocation.

Recognition by the Church

Pope Paul VI beatified him on December 5, 1965, and canonized him on October 9, 1977. Canonization is distinct from recognition of every personal testimony. Publishing or sharing a story does not automatically make it a formally recognized miracle.

Learning from his life today

Begin with a few minutes of silence and a passage from the Gospel. Choose a simple act of love: listen to someone who is lonely, ask forgiveness, or quietly help another person. Devotion can grow through these small, faithful habits.

Reading as a family

Let children ask questions and explain monastic life in words they can understand. Each person can choose an intention and a small act of kindness. The prayer and Annaya guides below offer ways to continue learning together.
